completion.releaseNote: My work is now the inbox: @name mentions and a count of what waits for you.
completion.summary: My work is the inbox. @name in a comment shows under Mentions for that person until they comment on the same record after it, or 14 days pass. The nav link and tab title show a count (needs-you + approvals + mentions, capped 99+, read to screen readers). No read state stored, no email or push. Also fixed the drag helper in e2e/ui/refusals.spec.ts: board auto-scroll moved the column from under a fixed drop point (failed 5 of 5 with and without this change). Verified: lint, typecheck, unit tests (UI 38), Playwright 95 of 95, bench all PASS. Commit d643a27.

title: In-app inbox for mentions, assignments, approvals and due dates
